meta.name: alternatives-generation
meta.description: Generate alternatives for every known approach — ensure no approach goes unchallenged.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为每个方案生成替代选项，避免思维定势
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要评估多种方案并做出最佳选择
copy.tagline_en: Generate alternatives for every approach to avoid blind spots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to evaluate multiple options and make the best choice

howto.what: Claude 会对每个已知方法生成不同的替代方案（不是变体，而是真正不同的选项），确保每个方法都被质疑。
howto.when: 当你提供一组已知方法（例如“A、B、C”），并要求为它们生成替代方案时触发。

say.text: 针对这三个方案，列出它们的替代方案。
say.note: Claude 会逐一给出不同方向的替代选项。

say.text: 帮我生成每个已知方法的替代方案，要求思路不同。
say.note: Claude 会产出与每个原方法有本质区别的方案。

say.text: 这个问题的常见解法是A、B、C，请给出替代方案。
say.note: Claude 会基于这些方法生成替代选项。

howto.what_en: Claude generates genuinely different alternatives (not variations) for every known approach the user provides, ensuring each approach is challenged.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a set of known approaches (e.g., "A, B, C") and ask for alternatives to them.

say_en.text: For these three approaches, list their alternatives.
say_en.note: Claude will produce distinct alternative options for each.

say_en.text: Generate alternatives for each known approach, requiring different thinking.
The common solutions are A, B, C; give me alternatives.
say_en.note: Claude will generate alternatives based on these approaches.
